WITH catalog AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT * FROM character_equipment_items i WHERE is_active=1 AND is_public=1 AND slot IN ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5) 
        
    ),growth AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT instance_id,level,revision FROM equipment_forge_states_v1 WHERE user_id=$6),
    normal AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT b.id AS instance_id,i.total_power AS current_power FROM catalog i
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b.id FROM user_equipment_instances b WHERE b.user_id=$7 AND b.equipment_id=i.id
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM growth s WHERE s.instance_id=b.id AND s.level>0)
    
      ORDER BY b.user_id DESC,b.equipment_id DESC,b.id DESC LIMIT $8) b),
    candidates AS (
      SELECT instance_id,current_power FROM normal
      UNION ALL SELECT x.id AS instance_id,CAST(i.total_power AS BIGINT)*(CASE s.level WHEN 0 THEN 100 WHEN 1 THEN 106 WHEN 2 THEN 112 WHEN 3 THEN 118 WHEN 4 THEN 124 WHEN 5 THEN 130 WHEN 6 THEN 136 WHEN 7 THEN 142 WHEN 8 THEN 148 WHEN 9 THEN 180 WHEN 10 THEN 220 WHEN 11 THEN 280 WHEN 12 THEN 340 WHEN 13 THEN 400 WHEN 14 THEN 460 WHEN 15 THEN 550 ELSE 100 END)/100 AS current_power
        FROM growth s JOIN user_equipment_instances x ON x.id=s.instance_id AND x.user_id=$9
        JOIN catalog i ON i.id=x.equipment_id WHERE s.level>0
        
    ),page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY current_power DESC,instance_id DESC LIMIT $10)
    SELECT x.id AS instance_id,x.equipment_id,x.acquired_at,
      i.code,i.name,i.slot,i.subtype,i.rarity,i.image_url,i.total_power,i.pve_power,i.pvp_power,
      COALESCE(s.level,0) AS level,COALESCE(s.revision,0) AS revision,
      CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_equipment_loadout l WHERE l.instance_id=x.id AND l.user_id=x.user_id AND l.slot=i.slot) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS equipped
    FROM page p JOIN user_equipment_instances x ON x.id=p.instance_id JOIN catalog i ON i.id=x.equipment_id
    LEFT JOIN growth s ON s.instance_id=x.id
    ORDER BY p.current_power DESC,p.instance_id DESC

performance.bottleneck: Pet reads remain 2 SQL and polish reads 10 SQL. Indexed pet metadata execution was 0.036 ms before; network round trips dominate the production handler. The new value table adds no query, network request, animation or polling. Local UI timings are single-run observations with shared-host scheduling variance.
performance.limits: Headless Windows Chrome and WebKit; mobile viewport/touch emulation and Windows launcher URL, H5 iframe with host SDK mock. Not physical phones or the installed Windows renderer. WebKit ResizeObserver warnings and long pet frames occurred before and after; Android after reentry recorded one 62.4 ms idle frame. Pet dice and polish animations had no >50 ms frame in the measured PC/Android samples.

polishMigration.optimization: A conditional bulk update replaces per-row network round trips while retaining the policy lock and exact prior-value checks. Partial and full rollback repeated using the bulk statement.
